text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
(It's almost time. The Classic GⅠs are 
about to begin. But...!)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
(Can I really compete with the strength I 
have right now? Dia-chan might not be 
here, but there are so many other 
incredible rivals...)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I want to see it for myself—with my own 
two eyes!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Senpais! I want to go see how our 
rivals run!

And so, with the Classic GⅠ races 
approaching, I came to inspect the 
racetrack with Tokai Teio, Mejiro McQueen, 
and a few other senior trainees.

Among those who came along were the 
blazing front-runner Silence Suzuka, 
Hokkaido native Special Week, and the wild 
troublemaker Gold Ship.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
First of all, one of this year's top 
contenders is "that Umamusume," isn't she?
(Rumble rumble rumble!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Onto the final stretch! Here she comes, 
here she comes! Brusqueman is already out 
in front! 3 lengths... 4 lengths... an 
overwhelming victory by 5 lengths!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
As expected of an Umamusume trained by the 
"Empress" Air Groove! She demonstrated an 
indisputable show of strength—!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, is that all? Still quite unpolished, 
but you've at least shown a glimpse of 
your potential.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Huh. Air Groove, that girl is Air Groove's 
daughter, huh...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Of course not! She's my mother's student! 
After retiring from racing, my mother ran 
a school and taught Umamusume how to run, 
you see.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Among them, that Brusqueman is a rising 
star. That is why I act as her advisor at 
the academy in my mother's stead."

This Umamusume is Air Groove. As the 
student council vice president, she's 
called "The Empress" because of her 
soaring ideals and formidable strength.

Air Groove's mother is a legendary 
Umamusume who made history, and it seems 
even that "Brusqueman" is one of those 
carrying on her teachings.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Brusqueman's Trainer! Moving forward, do 
you also have your sights set on the 
Classic GⅠs?

text_block_list.name: Talented Trainer
text_block_list.text:
"Of course. I was just contemplating 
whether to steer her toward the Classic 
Triple Crown or the Triple Tiara—"

text_block_list.name: Talented Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Two consecutive wins at 1,800m, and with 
performance like this, longer distances 
won't be an issue. We'll have her aim for 
the Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Talented Trainer
text_block_list.text: No problem, right, Brusquenade?

text_block_list.name: Brusqueman
text_block_list.text: ――Yes, sir.

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text: Oooh!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
The Triple Crown... We're rivals now, 
Kita-chan.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes... But...

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, you'll be one of the heavy 
favorites in the main event too!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
“Tell us about your chances of winning! 
What race are you considering as a prep 
race!?”

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Trainer... Is something... different?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Um... I'm not really sure how to put it 
into words, but... The journalists' 
interest, or rather, their enthusiasm...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I've never been surrounded like this 
before. Not at all, really...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Well, with a flashy victory like that, 
it's only natural.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: R-Right, of course... But still...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... Suzuka-san, this interview 
atmosphere feels kind of nostalgic, 
doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"I felt just like this during my Classic 
year. Were you the same, Suzuka-san?"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I wasn't very strong back then, but 
even so...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
The people around us were quite excited, 
weren't they? I'm not particularly fond of 
all this commotion...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
(Spe-san and Suzuka-san... are the same? 
Naturally, Teio-san had made a huge fuss 
too.)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: (And yet, I...)

And so, the press conference concluded, 
but— Kitasan Black spent the rest of that 
day lost deep in thought all by herself.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
(Is it just my imagination? The Classic 
Triple Crown... The season of a 
once-in-a-lifetime festival...)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
(Everyone's making a big fuss over them as 
the main stars. Brusqueman-san, and before 
that, Teio-san, Suzuka-san, and Spe-san 
too.)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
(Still, I'm different. It feels like 
what's obvious to everyone else isn't 
obvious to me. Like I'm the only one 
seeing a completely different view?)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
(I guess this is what they call a 
"difference in ability." I've gotta try 
way, way harder!)
